Name: Dark Mode Intro
Author: vapor64
Description:
[size=5][b]Dark Mode Intro[/b]

[/size][size=3]As the title says, this mod replaces the white background of ConcernedApe intro screen when the game starts, with dark grey.

[size=3]Please consider endorsing this mod if you find it helpful.[/size]

[b][u]Installation :[/u][/b][b][u]
[/u][/b][list]
[*]Download latest mod file
e.g. "[i]DarkModeIntro1.0.0.zip[/i]"[*]Extract the contents of the mod file to your Stardew Valley mods folder
e.g. "[i]C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\SteamApps\common\Stardew Valley\Mods\"[/i][*]Launch Stardew Valley using SMAPI
[/list]
[b][u]Compatibility :
[/u][/b][/size][list]
[*][size=3]Tested on Stardew Valley 1.6.15 and SMAPI 4.5.1[/size]
[*][size=3]Not tested on Android yet[/size]
[/list][size=3]
Source Code : [url=https://github.com/vapor-64/StardewModsSourceCode]Github
[/url][/size]If this mods helps you, please consider donating on [url=https://ko-fi.com/vapor64]Ko-fi[/url]
